WTF Is This

This report contains the list of games Phil is proposing to bring to Spain for Florida Bros Trip 2026. The current numbers:

16
On the menu
14
Locks
11
Maybes
2026
The Year of Our Lord

The “locks” are the games that are 100% in the bag no question about it I will fight any of you who try to argue with me.

The “maybes” are games I’m considering but have to be careful; picking from these will require dropping something else.

Games in the “other” category are games that technically fit my proposed criteria but I’m not actively considering, so feel free to argue with me.

Criteria:

  • Support 5 players (assuming Pat Scott has bought his plane ticket)
  • Petty player interaction
  • Small boxes preferred
  • Small table footprint preferred
  • Novelty preferred over nostalgia

Constraints:

  • Everything must fit into my board game carrying bag
